question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM** of the given word.

Eradicate
solution:
The correct answer is "**Conserve**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Conserve' means to protect something from harm or destruction.(संरक्षित करना)

 
 
• Example- We need to conserve our natural resources for future generations.
 
 
 
• '**Eradicate**' means to destroy completely; put an end to.(समाप्त करना)
 
 
• **Example**-The government pledged to eradicate poverty.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is opposite in meaning to the given word 'Eradicate' is 'Conserve'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options:
 
• **Culminate**: Reach a climax or point of highest development. (पराकाष्ठा पर पहुंचना)
 
• **Abolish**: Formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution. (समाप्त करना)
 
• **Deteriorate**: Become progressively worse. (बिगड़ना)
